page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top. Page number at the top left. Catchword at the lower right. No margin notes.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: jam usitata tempestive singulis semestribus locent, quanti omnino queant, & a conductoribus publicanis sponsiones idoneas dari curent, per quas Respub. indemnis esse possit, nec permittant, ut Quaestor aut quisquam alius munus a provincia acceptum gerens, aut pecuniam provinciae tractans, vectigalia tributaque huiusmodi conducat, aut in societate cum conductorum quoquam sit, aut etiam sponsorem se praestet: denique ut in eo sint, ne quid in fraudem provinciae tota hac in re a quoquam committatur, non a publicanis, non a provincialibus; ne publicanis fraus ulla fiat, ve ipsi praeter legem provinciales affligant, ut lites inter eos orta, quam citissime expediantur: ut potestatem habeant cum(Comite gubernatore militares praefecturas superiores & inferiores vacantes conferendi, modo ii, quibus conferuntur, non displiceant provinciae Ordinibus, quod cognoscendum proxime futuris comitiis: a reliquis vero curationibus aut muneribus quaestorum, secretariorum, armamentarii magistrorum, similiumque tribuendis abstineant, eamque curam comitiis relinquant: cum militares praefecturas conferent, intraneos, modo idonei sint, extraneis praeferant

page.notes: Line-end hyphens kept: "præ-" / "ferant" (catchword). Catchword "ferant" stands at right below the last line and is not repeated in the text. Long s set as plain s throughout. The printed "ue" before "ipsi" is read as "ve" (for neve). The printed "ij" after "modo" is read as "ii". The bracket before "Comite" is printed as "(" directly after "cum" and is kept as printed. Page number printed in an old form ("¾90") and read as 290. Faint stain at the lower left and watermark at the lower right are excluded.
